reason: My POS mostly works and I have 11-20 techs, many of them older. A new system means retraining everyone and risking a bad Saturday, and I never touch settings on Saturdays. The free trial next to my old system is nice, but I still would not start it.
objection: My staff are older, they will not learn a new system. If checkout breaks or confuses people on a busy Saturday, I lose real money and the techs get mad at me.
would_change_my_mind: Visiting a big salon like mine with 15+ techs that has run it for months, seeing the older techs use it without trouble, and a written promise that my current system stays on the Saturday counter until I say so.
